description: The Rütli is an open mountain meadow on Lake Uri, in the municipality of Seelisberg, canton of Uri, rather than in Schwyz. The grass slopes to a small boat landing, with a steep wooded hillside behind and mountains across the water. There is no statue on the meadow and no national-day crowd, because this scene is a late-September afternoon rather than 1 August. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, with soft light and no rain.
